interventions.detail: apt-get install cmake (and libssl-dev); cmake is not in the base image but needed to build llama.cpp
Installed torch from the PyTorch CPU wheel index instead of the default CUDA wheel
Installed llama.cpp requirements-convert_hf_to_gguf.txt into the conversion venv
Downloaded the HF model to /work/models/HunyuanOCR, not ./HunyuanOCR, to avoid colliding with the repo clone
docs say chat.py reads llama_cpp/test_assets/data.jsonl, but that file is missing from the repo; I tested with a direct HTTP request
